action.description: resolve = look up the reasoning cache; record = store a chain with its outcome; feedback = rate one.

agentId.description: Reasoning agent. For create and record.

chain.description: Ordered {step, reasoning, conclusion?}. Required for create/record; replaces it on patch.

conclusion.description: Where it ended. Required for create and record; also patch.

id.description: Required for get, patch and archive.

metadata.description: Free-form JSON. For create and patch.

outcome.description: success or fail. For record and feedback (required).

query.description: The question to look up. Required for resolve.

reasoningId.description: Record to rate. Required for feedback.

sensitivity.description: Set on create and record (patch refuses it).

status.description: For patch: new status. For list: a filter.

targetWorkspaceId.description: Write to this workspace UUID instead (needs write/admin; IDs: memory_context). action='create' only.

topicKey.description: Groups records on one question. For create, record, resolve.

topicKeyFilter.description: For list: only records with this topicKey.
